text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and connection resets for inference cluster in us-east-1. Auto-page triggered by SLO breach at 06:00 UTC (root 1774543210).
alex_oncall: ack — I'm taking triage. Paging @ben_sre and @karen_platform. Setting channel to incident.
ben_sre: seeing NLB target health checks flapping, lots of RSTs and client disconnects. Packet drops on a subset of instances.
ben_sre: quick metric dump: per-host ephemeral ports near exhaustion, TIME_WAIT ~300k on several hosts, connection_reuse low. ENI attach counts per host at account limit for the subnet.
karen_platform: possible causes: recent AMI kernel + ENA driver bump last night? or burst traffic from a large customer. I'll check deploys and Flow Logs.
ben_sre: logs show recent image roll (2026-06-16T23:40) on ~25% of pool. Those hosts show different ip_local_port_range and have tcp_tw_recycle toggled on — suspicious.
alex_oncall: customer impact: streaming generation timeouts for some customers, increased retries, a handful of paid requests failing. Maya, please prepare a status update and flag impacted org ids.
maya_support: opening incident ticket and reaching out to customers org-77, org-4912, org-COMPANYX. Posting: "Investigating increased errors for inference in us-east-1. We're working on mitigation now." :loudspeaker:
karen_platform: I'm going to reduce connection drain timeout on the NLB, lower keepalive, and prepare a Route53 weighted failover to us-west-2. Proposing staged weight 70/30 (west/east) to avoid cold-start spikes.
ben_sre: emergency mitigation checklist:
- adjust sysctl on affected hosts to expand ephemeral range and enable tcp_tw_reuse
- rotate out hosts with the suspect AMI
- route traffic away using Route53 weighted routing + health check overrides
- scale up us-west-2 capacity from reserved pool

ben_sre: sysctl snippet applied as hotfix via remote exec (non-persistent):
```
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=15000\ 61000
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1
```
ben_sre: after change on the first tranche (12 hosts) TIME_WAIT dropped ~45% and RSTs reduced noticeably.
karen_platform: applying Route53 weight change now (TTL 15s). CLI snippet: 
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZABC --change-batch file://change.json
```
(we used an 70/30 weight and enabled health-check override for quicker failover).
deploy-bot: deploying additional inference workers in us-west-2 (ASG scale + new images) started by @karen_platform at 06:12 UTC.
ben_sre: monitoring shows traffic shift to us-west-2, error rates overall dropping ~60% after weight change + sysctl. Some control-plane calls still hitting NAT gateway in us-east-1 and showing queue drops.
alex_oncall: can we add additional NAT gateways / move some subnets to different NAT to reduce single-subnet bottleneck?
karen_platform: yes — spinning up an extra NAT in a different AZ and changing route table for inference-subnet-b. This should reduce SNAT port contention for control-plane egress.
incident-bot: AWS support case created #CASE-2026-4930 (ENI/NAT/driver behavior).
maya_support: status update posted: "Traffic partially redirected to us-west-2; mitigation reduced errors. We're still monitoring; engineers continue work to replace affected hosts."
sre-lead: recommend mid-incident handoff in 30m if metrics remain improving. Also, tag this SEV2 pending customer impact confirmation.
jordan_night: taking over on-call at 06:30 UTC. thanks all. I'll keep Route53 weights and ASG changes in place until tomorrow morning.
jordan_night: immediate actions I'm tracking: keep 70/30 weight for 1 hour, finish rotating suspect AMI instances, add NAT redundancy, confirm AWS case escalation. Set alarms for TCP RST and TIME_WAIT thresholds.
ben_sre: fully replacing 30% of hosts with older stable AMI as a stopgap while we validate kernel/ENA changes. Drain and terminate affected instances via ASG lifecycle.
alex_oncall: checklist for post-incident follow-up (captured here):
- RCA: confirm whether kernel/ENA driver change caused ephemeral port behavior change
- Action: revert problematic AMI, or update init scripts to set safe ip_local_port_range/tcp_tw_reuse
- Infra: increase ENI/per-subnet quotas or add additional subnets for inference pools
- Networking: redesign NAT gateway placement for inference control-plane (multi-AZ, more SNAT capacity)
- Alerting: add ephemeral-port exhaustion detection and synthetic streaming checks for long-tail hops
- Customer comms: final RCA and timeline

maya_support: posting follow-up message to customers: "Mitigations have been applied and most traffic is serving from us-west-2. We will follow up with a root cause analysis and timeline for permanent fixes."
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigated (partial) — error rates down ~85% from peak; continuing to monitor. last update 1774544899
jordan_night: closing the active paging for now, overnight oncall will monitor. Scheduling RCA working session tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone for quick coordination.
